opening.argument: This video gives a practical technical demonstration of enabling multi-user support on Samsung Galaxy J7/J5 devices. It explains that the device must first be rooted, then directs the viewer to locate and edit build.prop, add the specified settings, save the file, and reboot. The demonstrated lines, “fw dot max underscore users is equal to 3 and fw dot show underscore multi-user ui is equal to one,” match the configuration shown in the editor, and the resulting interface displays Owner and Guest options. These concrete instructions and visible results support an educational purpose. The request to subscribe is channel engagement; the supplied evidence does not make it a condition for a financial benefit, credentials, or completing a transaction.
